comment: The maker names no port. A pulse width knob and its CV input are declared but commented out of the panel at src/view/Sequencer.cpp:62-68, so the gate length is stuck at the parameter's default of 5.05, which src/controller/Sequencer.cpp:155-159 turns into 505 samples. Input index 4 is that CV jack and has no census position, so it gets no line. The 128 pads are separate parameters with their own positions, so each one can be clicked; they are numbered by track times sixteen plus step, which the maker's own tooltip names confirm. Pattern selection by voltage is 10V divided by 17 (src/controller/Sequencer.cpp:4-14), about 0.588V per pattern.
